text: わかっとる　わかっとる　もちろん　おまえにも　たのむぞ！

structure.jp: わかっとる　わかっとる
おまえにも　たのむぞ！

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: ている says a state is in place now. とる is an old-man short form of ておる, which is the same as ている. わかっとる = 'I know (already)'.

patterns.name: 〜ぞ
patterns.explanation: ぞ at the end is a rough, strong way of pushing what you say at the listener. たのむぞ = 'I'm counting on you!'
